**Article Details for PMID: 42655937**

**Title:** Impact of Metformin Plus Lifestyle Intervention Compared With Lifestyle Intervention Alone on Prediabetes Remission in Participants With Impaired Glucose Regulation: The China DPP Study.

**Authors:** Siyao He, Yongmei Hao, Ping Tu, Su Wang, Xuan Wang, Xinhua Yin, Qing He, Zhongyan Shan, Xueqin Wang, Jinrong Liang, Chang Liu, Yun Xie, Binhong Duan, Wenbo Wang, Zhengnan Gao, Li Li, Qiuhong Gong, Guangwei Li, China Diabetes Prevention Program (CDPP) Study Group

**Journal:** Diabetes, obesity & metabolism
**Publication Date:** 2026-10-08
**DOI:** 10.1111/dom.71271

**Abstract:**
Prediabetes affects 35% of Chinese adults and is associated with increased risks of cardiovascular disease and mortality. However, findings are inconsistent on the effects of lifestyle and pharmacological interventions in the prediabetes population achieving remission. This analysis aimed to compare the effects of metformin plus lifestyle intervention versus lifestyle intervention alone for prediabetes remission.
